title: Write 15 · 包 票 读 雨 商 店 图 桌 馆 喝 穿 花 干 块 外
focus: 包 票 读 雨 商 店 图 桌 馆 喝 穿 花 干 块 外
body:
Shopping and food: 包, 票, 商店, 图书馆, 桌子, 喝.

## Repeating parts
- **口**: on the left of 喝 and inside 商.
- **广 / 囗 enclosures:** 店 sits under 广, and 图 is boxed in by 囗.
- **饣 food**: on the left of 馆.
- **土 earth**: on the left of 块.

## Rules that matter here
- **Close the box last:** in 图, write 丨 and 𠃍, then 冬 inside, then the bottom 一.
- **Top-left enclosures first:** 广 and 勹 go in before what they hold (店, 包).

cards.Notes: 勹 wrap (丿, 𠃌) around 巳 (𠃍, 一, 乚). 5 strokes. Write 勹 first, then 巳 inside. It is the phonetic in 跑, 饱, 抱.
覀 + 示. 11 strokes. 覀 (一, 丨, 𠃍, 丨, 丨, 一), then 示 (一, 一, 亅, 丿, 丶).
讠 speech + 卖 (a shape kept from the traditional 讀). 10 strokes. 讠, then 卖 (十, 乛, 头). Lookalike 续 xù has 纟.
Rain falling from a cloud. 8 strokes: 一, 丨, 𠃌, the middle 丨, then four dots (left pair, then right pair). As a top part (雪, 零) it is flattened.
11 strokes. 亠 on top, then 丷, then the 冂 frame. Inside it: 八, then 口. Don't mix it up with 高, which has 口 above the 冂.
广 building + 占 zhàn (phonetic). 8 strokes. 广 (丶, 一, 丿) first, then 占 (丨, 一, 口) under it.
囗 enclosure + 冬 dōng. 8 strokes. 丨 and 𠃍 first, then 冬 (丿, ㇇, ㇏, 丶, 丶) inside, and the bottom 一 last. Close the box last.
⺊ (丨, 一) over 日 over 木. 10 strokes, top to bottom. Lookalike 卓 zhuó has 十 at the bottom instead of 木.
饣 food + 官 guān (phonetic): a public building. 11 strokes. 饣 (丿, 乛, ㇙), then 官 (宀, then the stacked 㠯 shape).
口 mouth + 曷 hé (phonetic). 12 strokes. 口, then 曷: 日, then 勹 (丿, 𠃌), then 人, and 乚 last. Lookalike 渴 kě (thirsty) has 氵.

cards.Prompt: ＿衣服 · chuān yīfu · to get dressed
cards.Notes: 穴 cave + 牙 tooth: to bore through. 9 strokes. 穴 (宀 + 八), then 牙 (一, ㄣ, 亅, 丿).
艹 grass + 化 huà (phonetic). 7 strokes. 艹 (一, 丨, 丨), then 化 (亻, then 丿, 乚).
3 strokes: 一, 一, 丨. The top 一 is shorter than the bottom one. Read gàn in 干什么 (what are you doing). Lookalikes: 千 qiān (丿 on top), 于 yú (hooked vertical).

cards.Prompt: 一＿钱 · yí kuài qián · one yuan
cards.Notes: 土 earth + 夬 (phonetic): a lump. 7 strokes. 土 (一, 丨, ㇀), then 夬 (㇕, 一, 丿, ㇏). Same right side as 快 kuài.
夕 evening + 卜 divination. 5 strokes. 夕 (丿, ㇇, 丶), then 卜 (丨, 丶).
